reference.title: Fix daemon FD leak and add a generic leak guard
reference.summary: Closed GitHub issue #443: a daemon file-descriptor leak with two root causes. The FileSystemWatcher interface was missing a Remove() method, which meant kqueue FDs leaked whenever a watched directory was deleted — an abstraction gap, not a misuse. Separately, IndexLocalRepo opened go-git repos with KeepDescriptors but never called repo.Close(), so packfile FDs accumulated on every index. Fixed both and then elevated the test insight from the specific case into a reusable testguard.RequireNoFDLeak(t) helper that probes live FDs via fcntl(F_GETFD) — needed because macOS sandbox blocks /dev/fd. A regression test for the KeepDescriptors path required forcing git gc to create a packfile, since bare git init repos only have loose objects; even with that, go-git v6 FD cleanup semantics proved subtle and are documented in the test.
key_actions: Added Remove() to the FileSystemWatcher interface and wired kqueue cleanup on directory deletion
Added repo.Close() to IndexLocalRepo to release KeepDescriptors packfile FDs
Added a regression test that forces git gc to create a packfile for the KeepDescriptors path
Documented go-git v6 FD cleanup subtleties in the test
Verified make lint clean and full test suite green
